message.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
message.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for your offer and for your clear wish to build a long-term partnership. We value that, and we want to make it work on a solid footing.

Our data shows a different picture:

Your on-time delivery was 63.5% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).

Our orders of Bearing bracket HN with you were placed at EUR 46.33 on 2024-10-18 (po:4500011561-10), EUR 46.33 on 2025-06-20 (po:4500012598-10), EUR 45.15 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013441-20) and EUR 45.15 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014429-10): the price has not risen.

Given this, we would like to move forward with a firm proposal. It rests on dependable, steady work for your foundry and on reliable, punctual handling on our side:

Our proposal: quality commitment 2,500 ppm; chargeback EUR 500.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.05.

We look forward to your reply.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
message.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
message.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. You are right about the past prices and the delivery issues, we had some hiccups back then. 

We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351. 

We are happy to agree to the 2500 ppm to show we are serious about quality, but a 500 EUR chargeback is just too high. Our offer is a price of €48.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 2500 ppm, a chargeback of €500.00 per complaint. I changed the chargeback to 150 EUR, and with that trade I can offer you a lower price of 46.00 EUR. As an alternative, we have a package with a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 2500 ppm, a chargeback of €150.00 per complaint.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Quality: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

Freight Forwarder: Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. With overtime we can deliver in 56 days, at a premium.
